_about: Public-domain Thomas Buchanan Kilpatrick, Scottish-born Presbyterian theologian and professor at Knox College, Toronto, for the Word Hoard: Christian Conduct, Christian Character, A Summary of Christian Doctrine, New Testament Evangelism, The Redemption of Man, and Our Common Faith. He died in 1930; every book here was printed before then. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 130 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

kilpatrick-christian-conduct: Christian conduct :  a further study in New Testament morality (Edinburgh : T. & T. Clarke ; London, 1890)
kilpatrick-christian-character: Christian character : a study in New Testament morality (Edinburgh : T. & T. Clark, 1896)
kilpatrick-summary-doctrine: A summary of Christian doctrine (Toronto : R.D. Fraser, 1905)
kilpatrick-redemption-of-man: The redemption of man (New York : Scribner's, 1920)

_excluded.kilpatrick-butler: Butler's Sermons is Bishop Butler's book, which he edited
_excluded.kilpatrick-kootenay: The Kootenay Campaign is a short campaign report
